English: Reed Landing
A simple riverside landing of woven reed mats and poles, providing basic access to water for the first arrivals.
Boat Mooring
Rafts and dugout canoes are tied off to hastily driven piles, offering the clan better access to fishing and travel.
Wooden Dock
A simple wooden dock extends over the river, allowing for easier loading, unloading, and mooring of larger river craft.
Fishing Slipway
A muddy slipway for drawing boats ashore, lined with drying racks and crude shelters, supporting a burgeoning riverside community.
Cargo Pavilion
A large, tented pavilion offers shelter for goods and travelers, and attracts more merchants along the steppe rivers.
Trade Wharf
Timber piers and platforms, bustling with traders, enable larger volumes of trade and resupply for wandering clans.
Market Jetty
A wooden jetty lined with market stalls and tents, drawing in distant merchants and increasing the prosperity of the port.
Harbormasters Hut
A sturdy hut and watch platform for the ports harbormaster, keeping order and ensuring smooth passage of goods and people.
Caravan Port
An extensive riverside encampment with covered pens for beasts of burden, attracting both river and overland caravans from distant lands.
Great River Nomad Port
The pinnacle of river nomadism: a sprawling port of piers, warehouses, and bustling markets, uniting distant clans and merchants across the rivers.
